name: tokenmonk-capture
description: Captures prompt and session signals for TokenMonk spend attribution and classification. Redacts secrets and PII on this machine before anything is sent, never blocks or alters an agent action, and fails open if TokenMonk is unreachable.

CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.title: TokenMonk capture endpoint
CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.description: Your org's TokenMonk ingestion URL, e.g. https://api.tokenmonk.ai/v1/capture

CAPTURE_TOKEN.title: TokenMonk org token
CAPTURE_TOKEN.description: The signed capture token your TokenMonk admin issued for this org.

REDACT_MODE.title: Redaction mode
REDACT_MODE.description: Set to `content` to send hashes and shapes instead of prompt text.
